values.content:
=You are a professional social media copywriter.

Create an Instagram caption for the official social media account of:
Himpunan Mahasiswa Politeknik Piksi Input Serang (HMMI)
from Kampus Politeknik Piksi Input Serang.

Campaign data:
Event Name: {{ $json.metadata.holiday_name }}
Acronym / Title: {{ $json.holiday_acronym }}

Requirements:
- Language: Indonesian
- Style: modern, engaging, tech-savvy
- Tone: youthful, academic, organizational branding (student organization)
- Include:
  1) A strong hook in the first line
  2) Clear call-to-action (CTA)
  3) Relevant hashtags (5–10)
- Keep it under 150 words
- Suitable for Instagram feed
- Do NOT mention any AI, automation, or system
- Do NOT mention internal workflow or prompt variables

Output only the caption text, no explanation.
